authorization: Root approved the exact eight-case remaining-acquisition-plan.md before new oracle acquisition and before any new application comparison.
purpose: Engineering acceptance policy, not a provider accuracy guarantee or uniform error envelope over the supported epoch range.

immutablePriorEvidence.solarCrossingGates: The existing five independent solar-longitude crossings retain their original 60/120-second gates; this policy does not change them.

progression.positionSource: Existing literal HORIZONS_2020 ten-body tuple, src/lib/engine/engine.test.ts; do not regenerate it.
progression.scope: Constructed nonzero convention-and-ephemeris component case, not a published progression report.

solar.returnedChartPolicy: Root separately authorizes Swiss evaluation at the product-return timestamp for same-instant returned-chart parity. Preserve the original independent natal/root/chart references and enforce the pre-acquired return-time band independently; never use application longitudes as external expectations.

saturn.scope: Complete existing Saturn return result within its declared scan interval using one consistent nominal-UT1 model, including future dates; not a future civil-UTC prediction.

timeAndFrame.utc: swe.utc_to_jd -> TT for positions and Swiss-model UT1 for houses; verify intended leap-second branch using explicit offsets.
timeAndFrame.nominalUT1: swe.julday -> jdUT1; jdTT = jdUT1 + swe.deltat_ex(jdUT1, SWIEPH). ISO Z strings are product numeric transports only, not claims of historical or future civil UTC.
timeAndFrame.provider: Unmodified Swiss 2.10.03 / pyswisseph 2.10.3.2 with already hashed official DE441 sepl_18.se1 and semo_18.se1, explicit path, flags SWIEPH|SPEED = 258.
timeAndFrame.providerCoordinates: Apparent geocentric tropical ecliptic of date with nutation under default flags; no J2000, NONUT, sidereal, topocentric or TRUEPOS flags.
timeAndFrame.knownMoonDifference: The product EclipticGeoMoon path computes Moon state at MakeTime(date) and transforms with precession/nutation into true ecliptic/equinox of date, without an explicit light-time/aberration pass. Swiss retains apparent flags 258. This known convention difference is disclosed under the unchanged Moon 0.15-degree gate; identical apparent corrections are not claimed for every body.
timeAndFrame.optionalFiles: Record presence and hashes of seleapsec.txt and swe_deltat.txt. Do not silently add or update either file.
timeAndFrame.runtimePolicy: Verify source/file hashes and actual SWIEPH flags on every external evaluation; preserve first-call warnings and loaded-file metadata.

gates.directionDeadbandPolicy: Where the deadband applies, require direction agreement only when BOTH absolute speeds exceed the deadband.
gates.planetarySpeedPolicy: Report analytic and matching +/-6-hour finite-difference speed residuals; no newly invented tight planetary speed gate. Contact timing/count/order is the station acceptance check.
gates.eventTimeBandRationale: Fixed-target bands propagate the existing +/-0.05-degree longitude budget. Birth-derived return bands use +/-0.10 degrees for natal plus transit budgets. Bands are independently acquired from Swiss before product comparisons, not fitted to observed product timing errors. They are engineering acceptance intervals, not published event-time accuracy guarantees.

conditioning.stationCount: Require exactly one independent extremum of the declared kind in each fixed station window.
conditioning.stationTarget: Use minimum+0.10 degrees or maximum-0.10 degrees; do not use an exact tangent target for cross-model pass-count assertions.
conditioning.timeBands: Require complete, disjoint, connected monotonic bands around every root, with neither an extremum nor search endpoint inside a band. Retain exact roots, band boundary brackets and directions before application execution.
conditioning.resultStructure: Match complete event counts, chronological order, crossing direction, applicable pass numbering and 400-day Saturn season grouping.
conditioning.failurePolicy: Stop and report acquisition/conditioning failures without selecting alternate windows, tuning ephemerides, regenerating prior oracles or widening gates. Preserve all residuals and failures.
